rules.explanation: Google tag loader path and an own gtag function are reported in this capture.
caveats: The tag supports multiple destinations; this rule does not identify Analytics, Ads or a particular account.
The function may be a bootstrap stub and a DOM reference may never have executed.

rules.explanation: The script or frame path matches a Tag Manager container reference.
caveats: Configured tags and container identifiers are not inspected.
A frame reference or buffered entry does not establish which tags executed.

rules.explanation: The Stripe delivery host and a versioned or legacy loader path match a script observation.
caveats: No payment operation, loaded feature or data transfer is established.
Future loader paths and first-party proxies can require rule updates.

rules.explanation: A script observation names the documented Stripe delivery host.
caveats: This is an origin-only hint, deliberately weaker than a loader-path match.
An origin/name-only historical capture can satisfy this rule; it cannot identify a loader version.

rules.explanation: A documented loader path, or a div marker together with an own API object, is reported.
caveats: A marker by itself is only a partial hint.
No widget call, challenge, token or server validation is performed or inspected.

rules.explanation: The widget loader prefix and an own Intercom function are reported.
caveats: The function can be a queue stub; this does not establish initialization or message processing.
Workspace IDs, user details and SDK settings are not inspected.

rules.explanation: A cloud asset loader, or a cookie-name pattern together with an own posthog object, is reported.
caveats: Custom persistence names, self-hosting and proxies may not match.
A storage name can be stale and an object can be a bootstrap stub; no values or events are read.
